decisions.reason: The date-control Requirement already has a complete same-message MODIFY recording regular Enter as an additional date-entry method, so no added or edited Event is needed.
Enabling regular Enter for date entry does not change field-label content, help-text placement, persistence, or duplication rules.
The source changes the permitted date-entry method, not whether placeholder text clears when a field is activated.
The date-entry change does not alter the visible instructional text used to identify editable fields.
Allowing regular Enter in a date field does not change the requirement to preserve Title-field formatting during interaction.
The source specifies date-field input behavior but does not require a change to the general field architecture or editable-text mechanism.
Regular Enter input for the date field does not affect text wrapping or adjacent-column stability.
The source changes date-entry interaction only and does not modify the Danish date placeholder or other user-facing text.
The date-field input option is independent of checklist and dropdown control configuration.
The source does not change text-to-border spacing; shared references to fields and Enter are incidental.
Regular Enter as a date-entry method does not change Enter-key behavior in designated bullet fields.
The date-field interaction decision has no effect on theme-color inclusion or available color options.
